clips.title: The story
paras: This leg of the investigation directs searchers to the Canals of Stormwind City, where Caretaker Folsom watches over the remaining possessions of the ruined Flintridge family. Looking for answers regarding the mysterious Stalvan Mistmantle, adventurers must dig through crated estate goods while confronting restless spirits tied to a past massacre.

Tracking Stalvan's movements leads out of the shadowed groves of Duskwood and into the heart of Stormwind. Beside the city canals, Caretaker Folsom looks after what little remains of the Flintridge household. According to Folsom, his father served the estate before him and had the grisly task of mopping up blood in the wake of a horrific household slaughter—a tragedy somehow tied to the name Stalvan.

With the Flintridge trust funds entirely drained and royal tax vultures circling, the family's surviving heirlooms and packed belongings are slated for auction. Whatever keepsakes and papers survived the bloodshed sit piled into shipping crates along the canal embankment. Uncovering Stalvan's trail requires prying open these sealed boxes before the estate's remaining worldly goods are scattered to collectors across the kingdom.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: My father was the caretaker of the estate long before I was. He had to mop the blood up after the massacre. But that's neither here nor there.

The last funds of the Flintridge trust have dried up. Now the last of the family possessions are headed for auction. Blame the tax vultures. I guess if you're really itching to learn more you're free to look through this junk. Who knows what you might find.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You slowly slide the lid of the crate off....
